output_contract: One cold~100k seed then C4 independent cold~10k peers and3 true conversation turns, each appending actual in-memory assistant text plus a fixed new user message. Exact actual outputs, full request/message hashes, dependency chain, cache counts and C4 visible coverage required; no full-live cache assumption.
timing_limits: Synthetic true assistant/user continuation; no tools or private conversation content.
Count preflight is stateless; actual API/native count equality is mandatory.
SSE deltas are not token timing. First extension must restore; subsequent extensions may retain live state.
